documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations of INR 282.95 crores, up 18% year-on-year, with PAT increasing 42% to INR 57.99 crores. Growth was driven by dispatches from overseas warehouses and order execution for export automotive OEMs. The company plans to commission a new production line in Q1 FY28 and is considering new plant setups in South India or Mexico. Management aims to sustain gross margins around 55% to 56% while targeting auto export OEM revenue of INR 300 crores in FY27. Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported Q1 FY27 standalone revenue of INR 247.03 crores and PAT of INR 58.95 crores, representing year-on-year growth driven primarily by product mix and price realization.

guidance.claim: Management expects sales growth and increased business momentum to continue over the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects auto export OEM sales to reach around INR 300 crores in the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: Last year, it was INR260 crores. And this year, we are expecting INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects retail export business growth to continue improving in double digits.
guidance.quote: And further, we are expecting it will continue to improve in double digit.

guidance.claim: Management expects top-line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

guidance.claim: Sales growth and momentum are expected to continue over the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects sustainable margins to remain around 25% plus 1% or 2%.
guidance.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

guidance.claim: Management expects domestic growth between 8% to 10% and export growth between 15% to 20% in value terms.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: The company expects exports to constitute nearly 40% to 45% of its revenue mix.
guidance.quote: Nearly 40%-45% will be our export. We are expecting, yes. This will be the range and remaining balance is domestic revenue.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain margins in the range of 25% to 30%.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin.

demand_outlook.claim: The U.S. automotive market has been weak for the last two quarters as end customers delayed buying new cars.
demand_outlook.quote: Basically, market is not responding well in U.S. for last 2 quarters. And the customers are not going for buying the new cars. Therefore, the automotive companies have revised their projections.

demand_outlook.claim: South African export clients Mercedes-Benz and BMW have touched almost their full projections.
demand_outlook.quote: BMW and Mercedes-Benz, they are taking material as per their requirement and they have touched almost full projections.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic furnishing retail demand has faced weakness over the past 5 to 6 months due to price competition.
demand_outlook.quote: But in the last 5, 6 months, some domestic market on retail segment is not doing well because of price competition.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced degrowth in the domestic footwear segment during the quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Okay. That is not necessarily true, excepting domestic footwear market where we have had a degrowth in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects strong revenue growth to come from export markets rather than domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Total export volume grew by over 9%, while domestic volume grew by 1%.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume growth for domestic and export is in total. Export is 9% plus is the growth rate and 1% is domestic growth rate.

demand_outlook.claim: In FY26, Mayur Uniquoters achieved 15% overall value growth, comprising 35.5% growth in exports and over 4% growth in domestic business.
demand_outlook.quote: Actually, we registered a total growth of 15% in value and out of that, around 35.5%, we achieved the growth in export and 4% plus we achieved in domestic.

demand_outlook.claim: Total volume sold in FY26 was 31 million meters.
The PU business generated revenue of INR 27.08 crores for the complete financial year FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: Equipment for a new line is expected in November-December, with installation starting in the March quarter and operations beginning in Q1.
capex_expansion.quote: The machinery and equipment part is expected in November end and December and we'll try to start installation in March quarter. And hopefully, it will start in Q1.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning potential new manufacturing facilities in South India or Mexico.
capex_expansion.quote: Definitely, we are thinking and have plan in mind for setting up the new plant in India, especially in South region. And if we go outside India, then definitely Mexico.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capex for FY27 is around INR 50 crores.
An international facility setup could entail a capex of INR 250 crores over the next two years if finalized.
capex_expansion.quote: 2027, 2028 can't tell you exact figure, depends -- if we have taken a final call on putting up a new facility somewhere. So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Mayur Uniquoters has ordered a coating line to be set up in an existing facility rather than in South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex required for a plant at a global location would be around INR 300 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

margins_costs.claim: Management targets a sustainable gross margin of around 55% to 56%.
Quarterly employee costs remain steady at approximately INR 12.5 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Otherwise, the total cost is same, 12.5% yield, and INR12.5 crores per quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins improved over standalone numbers due to higher sales dispatches from overseas warehouses.
margins_costs.quote: This time, we have reduced our dispatch from India and increased dispatches or sales from warehouse. That's why consolidated margins, you've seen improved and better than stand-alone.

margins_costs.claim: High shipping costs resulting from war situations impacted Q1 pricing and expenses.
margins_costs.quote: The first one, because of the Gulf War the problem arises that impacted the price in Q1. And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices started increasing in March, leading to market volatility.
margins_costs.quote: So obviously, there was an increase in the raw material prices, which started happening in the month of March. And the market has been very volatile since then.

margins_costs.claim: The company gained a 10% natural price increase from US dollar appreciation.
margins_costs.quote: 10% already received a 10% price increase, right? in terms of dollar rate.

margins_costs.claim: In Q4 FY26, standalone revenue increased by 22% while PBT and PAT increased by 70% and 73% year-on-year respectively.
margins_costs.quote: In the quarter, the standalone revenue increased by 22%, PBT and PAT both increased by 70% and 73% on Y-on-Y basis.

margins_costs.claim: Other income for the year included foreign exchange gains of approximately INR 30 crores.
margins_costs.quote: And our other income includes this foreign exchange gain of around INR 30 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Employee expenses increased in Q4 FY26 due to the provisional impact of new labor codes along with new hiring.
margins_costs.quote: No, actually it has impact of new labor codes provisional impact, that is the impact employee benefit expenses and new hiring is also.

orders_capacity.claim: The PU facility is operating at 25% capacity utilization and requires 40% utilization to reach breakeven.
orders_capacity.quote: PU, it's not, in fact, generating profit just -- but we are managing because of some tax benefits and all. But still we are operating at 25% capacity utilization. And to get the breakeven, we need to operate at 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: U.S. automotive customers Ford and Chrysler expanded order allocations from 2 vehicle models to 5 models.
orders_capacity.quote: In the U.S. We have received the very good amount of orders or quantity, mainly Ford and Chrysler. And customers are same, but they have increased their requirement on other models also. So suppose, earlier, we were supplying materials for 2 models. Now they have given us orders for 5 models.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone sales volume reached 77.51 lakh meters during Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total quantity was 77.51 lakhs meters, and we have booked the PU revenue INR6.28 crores in this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently operating at a capacity utilization rate between 75% to 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: The monthly PVC production capacity stands between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The company received good OEM supply orders from the US that have started contributing to export sales and business profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line will add an average monthly capacity of 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line is expected to generate additional revenue of INR 120 crore to INR 150 crore.
orders_capacity.quote: So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's investment in the Bhadla Mini Grid Solar project carries a maximum payback period of 2 years.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it's payback period is 2 years only. Maximum 2 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs rose significantly due to geopolitical conflict and elevated crude oil prices, reaching peak levels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because increase in freight cost is because of that war and crude oil prices and all. But now it has gone to a very peak level, which we have seen during COVID.

risks_headwinds.claim: Market volatility, tariffs, and geopolitical conflicts have prevented management from finalizing international expansion locations.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export freight shipping costs increased fourfold during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account.

risks_headwinds.claim: The PU synthetic leather market faces intense competition from Chinese suppliers.
risks_headwinds.quote: PU, there is a lot of intense competition from China for sure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Prices of petroleum by-product raw materials increased significantly in March.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly.

risks_headwinds.claim: General export shipments to the Middle East were temporarily on hold in the last quarter due to the war situation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, what happened in the last quarter, because of the war situation, our general export market was temporarily impacted. Because there was some material that was supposed to go to the Middle East, but we could not dispatch that material, it was on hold.

management_commitments.claim: Sales growth and increased momentum are expected to continue over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Auto export OEM revenue is projected to reach INR 300 crores during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Last year, it was INR260 crores. And this year, we are expecting INR300 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Installation of machinery for the additional line is scheduled to start in the March quarter with expected operational launch in Q1.
management_commitments.quote: The machinery and equipment part is expected in November end and December and we'll try to start installation in March quarter. And hopefully, it will start in Q1.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to start production on its ordered expansion line towards the end of the financial year between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects top-line growth of between 10% to 12% over the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects US automotive business to increase by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: The export business growth momentum is expected to continue for the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The setup of the new coating line at the existing location is planned for completion by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.
management_commitments.timeframe: by the end of this calendar year

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
